subject: general
question: A major population of Israel is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jewish**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A major population of Israel is Jewish.**
 
• **Israeli citizens** and nationals who are **Jewish by virtue **of either their Jewish ethnicity or their practice of Judaism are known as Israeli Jews or Jewish Israelis.
 
• The word also refers to the offspring of Jewish Israelis who left the country and moved elsewhere.
 
• **Jewish Israelis** are the modern offspring of the ancient Israelites and Hebrews, together with Samaritans and communities from the scattered Jewish diaspora.
 
• As well as in smaller numbers in other nations throughout the world, they are mostly found in Israel and the West.
 
• Hebrew is a Semitic language spoken as a first language by the vast majority of Israeli Jews.
 
• The only nation with a majority of Jews is the Jewish state of Israel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Iranians known as Lurs** inhabit the highlands of western Iran. The Bakhtiari, Mamasani, Kohgiluyeh, and Lur proper are the four Luri branches, and they are primarily connected through the Luri language.
 
• With 35,734 residents, **Beja** is a municipality in the Alentejo Region of southern Portugal.
 
• A Dravidian ethnic group known as the **Toda **lives in Tamil Nadu, India's Nilgiri Mountains.
